newsitem.title: CHINA: China Xinjiang region cotton output to rise in 96.
newsitem.headline: China Xinjiang region cotton output to rise in 96.

text.p: Cotton production in China's northwestern Xinjiang region is seen hitting 1.05 million tonnes in 1996, 125,000 tonnes up on 1995 output, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
The forecast harvest would be a record for the region if the crop was not damaged by winter frosts, Xinhua said.
The area of land under cotton in Xinjiang had increased to 785,000 hectares this year, a rise of 54,100 hectares compared with last year, it said.
Cotton farmers had also boosted the use of fertilisers, the agency said. Xinjiang is China's largest single cotton-producing region.
China's produced a cotton harvest of 4.5 million tonnes last year.
